title: Northgate Care Protection Plans Price Schedule
content:
Every Northgate Care Protection Plans contract is priced from a band schedule set against the price of the product it covers. For each plan, the bands below are read in order from the lowest; the first band whose upper limit is at or above the covered product's price sets the plan price.

## Reading a band (hypothetical prices)

- A band's upper limit belongs to that band. On the Northgate Care 2-Year Electronics Plan, a hypothetical covered product priced 199.99 falls in the first band, plan price 19.99; one priced 200.00 is above that limit, so the first band whose limit is at or above it is the 499.99 band, plan price 39.99.
- On the Northgate Care 5-Year Appliance Plan, a hypothetical covered product priced 5000.00 is above the 4999.99 limit and falls in the 7999.99 band, plan price 549.99.
- The bands of one plan say nothing about another plan: the same hypothetical 450.00 product prices at 39.99 on the Northgate Care 2-Year Electronics Plan and at 69.99 on the Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan.
